title: A student record
description:
Group data with a struct and pass it by pointer.

```
Ada Lovelace, age 36, marks 91 85 78 -> average 84.67 (B)
Best student: Grace Hopper
```
hints: Passing `const Student *` avoids copying the whole struct and promises not to change it.
requirements: `typedef struct { char name[32]; int age; int marks[3]; } Student;`
`double average(const Student *s)` and `char grade(const Student *s)` (90+ A, 80+ B, 70+ C, else D).
An array of three students; find the best average.
stretch: Sort the students by average with `qsort` and a comparison function on `Student`.
